description_en: Queries the execution details of a specific SQL statement, including the execution plan, runtime information, resource usage, and self-diagnostics results
description_zh: 查看某个SQL的执行详情，包括执行计划、运行信息、资源使用、自诊断结果等
kebab_example: aliyun adb describe-diagnosis-sql-info --db-cluster-id amv-bp1r053by0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-12-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDiagnosisSQLInfo

parameters.help_en:
The cluster ID.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html operation to query the cluster IDs of AnalyticDB for MySQL clusters in a specific region
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html接口查看目标地域下AnalyticDB MySQL集群的集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/143074.html operation to query the region IDs supported by AnalyticDB for MySQL
parameters.help_zh:
地域ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/143074.html接口查看AnalyticDB MySQL支持的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The query ID.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/308207.html operation to query the SQL summary information of a specific AnalyticDB for MySQL cluster, including the query ID
parameters.help_zh:
查询ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/308207.html接口查看指定的AnalyticDB MySQL集群中SQL摘要信息，包括查询ID
parameters.name: process_id

parameters.help_en:
The start time of the SQL statement execution. Specify the value as a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/308207.html operation to query the SQL summary information of a specific AnalyticDB for MySQL cluster, including the start time of the SQL statement execution
parameters.help_zh:
SQL语句的执行开始时间，格式为Unix时间戳，单位为毫秒（ms）。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/308207.html接口查看指定的AnalyticDB MySQL集群中SQL摘要信息，包括SQL语句的执行开始时间
parameters.name: process_start_time

parameters.help_en:
The status of the SQL statement. Valid values:
running: The SQL statement is being executed.
finished: The SQL statement has been executed.
failed: The SQL statement failed to be executed.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/308207.html operation to query the SQL summary information of a specific AnalyticDB for MySQL cluster, including the status of the SQL statement
parameters.help_zh:
SQL语句的状态，取值如下：
running：执行中。
finished：已完成。
failed：执行失败。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/308207.html接口查看指定的AnalyticDB MySQL集群中SQL摘要信息，包括SQL语句的状态信息
parameters.name: process_state

parameters.help_en:
The language of the file title and error messages in the downloaded file. Valid values:
zh: simplified Chinese.
en: English.
ja: Japanese.
zh-tw: traditional Chinese
parameters.help_zh:
设置下载文件的文件标题以及部分错误信息的语言，支持如下语言：
zh：简体中文。
en：英文。
ja：日语。
zh-tw：繁体中文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en:
The IP address and port number of the AnalyticDB for MySQL frontend node that executes the SQL statement.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/308207.html operation to query the SQL summary information of a specific AnalyticDB for MySQL cluster, including the IP address and port number of the frontend node
parameters.help_zh:
执行SQL语句的AnalyticDB MySQL前端节点IP和端口信息。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/308207.html接口查看指定的AnalyticDB MySQL集群中SQL摘要信息，包括前端节点IP和端口信息
parameters.name: process_rc_host

DiagnosisSQLInfo.description_en: The execution details of the SQL statement, including the detailed SQL statement, statistics information, execution plan, and operator information
DiagnosisSQLInfo.description_zh: SQL的执行详情，包括详细的SQL语句、统计信息、执行计划和算子信息等
